By winning the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Mayano 
Top Gun grew into an Umamusume who could 
truly bring genuine excitement to the 
fans.

A few days later... during training, 
Mayano Top Gun spotted Narita Brian 
running alongside Symboli Rudolf.

Seeing Narita Brian shine even brighter, 
Mayano Top Gun resolves to run the Arima 
Kinen with everything she's got.
